issue.body:
h11(0.8.1), latest starlette/guvicorn ... on python3.7.0/windows10

this simple app:
```python
from starlette.applications import Starlette
from starlette.responses import RedirectResponse
import uvicorn

app = Starlette()
app.debug=True

@app.route('/')
async def simplest(request):
    r=RedirectResponse( "http://example.com" )
    r.set_cookie("mycake", "myvalue", path="/", max_age=546546546, httponly=True)
    return r

if __name__=="__main__":
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8080)
```

produce

```
  File "...\h11\_util.py", line 96, in validate
    raise LocalProtocolError(msg)
h11._util.LocalProtocolError: Illegal header value b' mycake=myvalue; HttpOnly; Max-Age=546546546; Path=/'
```
